page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7se.6xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. The instance features 24 dedicated vCPUs derived from 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The processor includes a 48 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AES-NI, and SHA extensions.

This instance does not include local storage, relying instead on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth. In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.r7se.6xlarge demonstrates average performance across several categories. It achieves a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 23340.47 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 12181.0. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only large block speed of 135.11 GB/sec and a write large block speed of 65.44 GB/sec.

The instance exhibits strong performance in specific tasks, such as text generation using a small 135M parameter LLM, where it achieves 298.41 tokens per second. For medium 7B parameter LLM inference, it processes prompts at 48.55 tokens per second and generates text at 15.85 tokens per second. Given its high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.r7se.6xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. It is well-suited for in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise applications, and moderate data processing pipelines.
